message: dangerously-allow-all-builds=1 in .npmrc makes pnpm 10.28.0 run every dependency build script (it reads every value but false, null and undefined as true), because pnpm-workspace.yaml has no build settings that override it, but depcurfew.json denies install scripts
fix: Remove the line from .npmrc, or run depcurfew apply, which sets dangerouslyAllowAllBuilds: false in pnpm-workspace.yaml
